basis: Defined by hypertrophy of the skin's stratum corneum; other organ involvement is not shared across this umbrella.
Congenital facial and abducens palsies define it; limb/muscle malformations occur in 30-79%, dental abnormalities in 37%; hearing impairment is occasional.
Ovarian metastasis usually originates in the stomach or another gastrointestinal site; ovarian and breast tissue have no axis.
Active Meniere disease affects cochlear hearing and vestibular function in the inner ear.
Bacterial infection directly inflames and damages the myocardium.
Congenital keratinization disorder; ectropion affects 7/8 patients and directly disrupts eyelid function.
MS, ichthyosis and coagulation deficiency define it; optic atrophy/neuritis occurs in 80-99%; immune mechanism omitted because of the four-axis cap.
Tumour occupies the spinal epidural compartment and commonly compresses neural structures; vascularity alone does not establish cardiovascular disease.
Isolated congenital absence of part or all of the cerebellar vermis.
Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy directly damages skeletal muscle; intellectual disability occurs in 30-79%; biliary atresia is occasional.
Bacterial infection umbrella covering multiple anatomical sites; no individual organ is consistently affected across the group.
Carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; endometrioid describes histology.
Microcephaly and intellectual disability define it; frequencies of associated hypothyroidism and ocular abnormalities are insufficiently established.
Lysosomal disorder with neuroregression; skeletal dysostosis and vertebral/joint abnormalities are common (~30%+); hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver damage.
Axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy; persistent muscle atrophy and structural foot deformities occur in 30-79%; LMNA alone does not imply cardiac disease.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and seizures; hearing impairment reported in 2/2 assessed patients, with uncertain broader frequency; central hypoventilation is not lung damage.
Degeneration directly affects the retinal macula.
Chronic fibrocalculous injury of the exocrine pancreas; associated diabetes is separately diagnosed, and pancreatic cancer is a later risk.
Generalized reflex epilepsy; eyelid myoclonia and photosensitivity reflect seizures rather than intrinsic ocular damage.
Malignancy of the intracranial choroid plexus; its vascular anatomy does not make this a primary cardiovascular malignancy.
Benign epithelial neoplasm arising in the colon.
Invasive epithelial carcinoma originating in the colon.
Skeletal/ectodermal dysplasia with nephronophthisis; hepatic fibrosis is a major feature (~30-50%); dental defects (80-99%) and variable retinal disease omitted at cap.
Neurodevelopmental syndrome; generalized amyotrophy, optic disc pallor and eczematoid dermatitis each annotated at 80-99%; low IGF1 alone does not establish endocrine disease.
Acquired porphyrin metabolism disorder, predominantly sporadic PCT; chronic blistering skin injury occurs in most symptomatic cases; liver dysfunction is not universal.
